answer: Sybil resistance here comes from a staked identity registry. Each controller must post a bond far above any per-epoch payout before it can vote, grade, or earn, and that bond is the sole collateral for every identity it owns. Operators register on-chain in advance, so when a challenge proves several accounts share one hidden controller, the cluster is slashed and the relic of each duplicate claim is voided. A thousand fake jade wallets cost a thousand full bonds, not a thousand cheap mails, so juniper farming earns less than the capital it commits.
